mapper.sql: esr.score_rule_id as "scoreRuleId", esr.rule_version_id as "ruleVersionId", erv.version_code as "versionCode", erv.version_status as "versionStatus", emi.management_item_id as "managementItemId", ea.area_code as "areaCode", ea.area_name as "areaName", ei.item_code as "itemCode", ei.item_name as "itemName", ee.evaluation_year as "evaluationYear", ee.element_code as "elementCode", ee.element_name as "elementName", emi.management_item_code as "managementItemCode", emi.management_item_name as "managementItemName", esr.organization_code as "organizationCode", org.organization_name as "organizationName", esr.base_score as "baseScore", esr.max_score as "maxScore", esr.effective_start_date as "effectiveStartDate", esr.effective_end_date as "effectiveEndDate", esr.active_yn as "activeYn", esr.change_reason as "changeReason", esr.updated_by as "updatedBy", esr.updated_at as "updatedAt"

from evaluation_score_rules esr inner join evaluation_rule_versions erv on erv.rule_version_id = esr.rule_version_id inner join evaluation_management_items emi on emi.management_item_id = esr.management_item_id inner join evaluation_elements ee on ee.element_id = emi.element_id inner join evaluation_items ei on ei.item_id = ee.item_id inner join evaluation_areas ea on ea.area_id = ei.area_id left join organizations org on org.organization_code = esr.organization_code

where.if: and (emi.management_item_code ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or emi.management_item_name ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or ee.element_code ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or ee.element_name ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or ei.item_code ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or ei.item_name ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or ea.area_code ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or ea.area_name ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or esr.organization_code ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or org.organization_name ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%'))

mapper.insert: insert into evaluation_score_rules (rule_version_id, management_item_id, organization_code, evaluation_year, base_score, max_score, effective_start_date, effective_end_date, active_yn, change_reason, created_by, updated_by) values (#{request.ruleVersionId}, #{request.managementItemId}, #{request.organizationCode}, #{request.evaluationYear}, #{request.baseScore}, #{request.maxScore}, #{request.effectiveStartDate}, #{request.effectiveEndDate}, #{request.activeYn}, #{request.changeReason}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedBy}) on conflict (rule_version_id, management_item_id, organization_code, evaluation_year, effective_start_date, effective_end_date) do update set base_score = EXCLUDED.base_score, max_score = EXCLUDED.max_score, active_yn = EXCLUDED.active_yn, change_reason = EXCLUDED.change_reason, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by

insert into data_change_histories (target_business, target_key, change_type, field_name, before_value, after_value, changed_by, change_reason, request_id) values (#{targetBusiness}, #{targetKey}, #{changeType}, #{fieldName}, #{beforeValue}, #{afterValue}, #{changedBy}, #{changeReason}, #{requestId})
